questions.question: Which mist did relic stones help the Blessed Isles navigate, powering their beacons before the Ruination?
questions.answer: Unlike most magical artifacts, made for one task, relic stones can heal, fire bolts of magic, raise barriers or open sealed doors, depending on how they are carved.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Hextech
questions.question: Which volatile crystal does hextech need to work?
questions.answer: Raw hexite explodes at the slightest impact. Refined into hextech gemstones, small blue spheres, it can take great impacts and power devices anyone can use.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hextech
questions.question: Which of these champions uses a custom hextech rifle built by Jayce?
questions.answer: Hextech channels rune magic through science and mathematics, so that anyone can wield its devices, not only those born with a gift for magic.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hextech
questions.question: Which of these champions fires handcrafted hextech bullets from his pistol?
questions.answer: His pistol, Whisper, is built with exacting precision to fire only four shots.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hextech
questions.question: Which of these champions performs on a hextech stage platform?
questions.answer: The stage, Echoes of the Heart, is what her abilities in the game are channelled through.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hextech
questions.question: Which of these champions is a hextech golem said to have evolved all on its own?
questions.answer: Hextech golems vary in size, shape, purpose and intelligence. This one can shoot out its hand like a grappling hook.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Hextech
questions.question: Which of these champions wanted to weaponize hextech, but found no scientist who could master it?
questions.answer: Overuse of hextech later caused fluctuations in the arcane that corrupted plants, surfaces and machinery.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Chemtech
questions.question: Which of these champions runs a company making weapons, prosthetics and beauty products from her parents' chemicals?
questions.answer: Glasc Industries' chemtech is purple: a more expensive, refined and stable kind than the common green.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Chemtech
questions.question: Which of these champions is called a living example of how far chemtech can push the human psyche?
questions.answer: Chemtech works like hextech, but is far more unstable, toxic and explosive. Many Zaunites turned to it to cope with bodies damaged by the city's pollution.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Chemtech
questions.question: Which chemtech suits make their wearers stronger by feeding them shimmer gas through their helmets?
questions.answer: They are used mostly as grunts for security, and carry retractable twin blades.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Shimmer
questions.question: Which of these was shimmer first made from?
questions.answer: The flowers grew in the caves of Zaun. Shimmer was first meant as a healing drug, and in small amounts it does speed up healing.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Shimmer
questions.question: Which kind of animal was Rio, the first known shimmer test subject?
questions.answer: Rio had a rare mutation that was key to making shimmer.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Shimmer
questions.question: Which of these champions was forcibly injected with a purple liquid resembling shimmer?
questions.answer: It drastically altered his brain and biology. Large doses of shimmer bring superhuman strength, along with a sharp loss of cognitive ability.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Shimmer
questions.question: Which of these champions led the Firelights in their fight to rid Zaun of shimmer?
questions.answer: Shimmer is still made today: a deal to shut down its factories in exchange for Zaun's independence never came to pass.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions affectionately calls her hammer Whomper?
questions.answer: The hammer once belonged to Orlon, the First King of Demacia, who gave it to his best friend.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields an extendable staff forged by the legendary smith Doran?
questions.answer: After Doran's death the staff came to Master Yi, who gave it to his brightest pupil.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields a mace called Nightfall?
questions.answer: It is made from the souls of the necromancers who summoned him back from the afterlife after his first death.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wears the Nether Blade of Horok, a gauntlet that belonged to a Shuriman God-Warrior?
questions.answer: The blade became warped, gaining a cold pull of oblivion in its edge. Horok's other, left-handed gauntlet was stolen by Ne'Zuk.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions found the gauntlet that let Ne'Zuk jump instantly from place to place?
questions.answer: The left-handed gauntlet first belonged to the Shuriman God-Warrior Horok, before Ne'Zuk stole it.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions stole the Chalicar, a jeweled crossblade?
questions.answer: It was first wielded by Setaka, Warrior Queen of the Ascended Host.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields the Ohmlatl, a ring-shaped Ixtali blade?
questions.answer: The blade channels elemental magic, which is released through acrobatics such as spinning and tossing it.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields a spirit blade passed down by his father, Kusho?
questions.answer: The blade is connected to the Spirit Realm and is used to cut spirits.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions received the prayer-bead relic Aion Er'na from her master, Lao?
questions.answer: Lao was an ancient Fist of Shadow, who passed the relic down to his student.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields Judgment, an ancestral sun-steel broadsword?
questions.answer: The sword has been passed down House Crownguard for generations. It is infused with petricite, whose power to expel magic seemed forgotten until the mage rebellions.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields the extendable lance Drakebane?
questions.answer: It is made of steel infused with petricite, and passed down through Demacia's royal line.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions once used the spear that is now embedded in Kalista's chest?
questions.answer: The black spear was once used by the Grand Master of the Iron Order.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions named his scrap-metal mecha after Tristana?
questions.answer: Tristana's own cannon, Boomer, was commissioned from a Bilgewater gunsmith.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which city did the gunsmith who made Tristana's cannon, Boomer, come from?
questions.answer: The small black powder cannon was modified so that a yordle could use it.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which sentient tome lets its reader travel instantly to any place drawn in its thousand pages?
questions.answer: Yuumi watches over the book, which belonged to her master, Norra.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions channels her god's power through an idol called the Eye of God?
questions.answer: The idol depicts Nagakabouros and is used by the Truth Bearers of the Buhru.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions carries a shotgun called New Destiny?
questions.answer: It replaced his old shotgun, Destiny, which he lost during the Burning Tides.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these are Miss Fortune's twin pistols?
questions.answer: Her flagship is the Syren, a small, sleek and decorated schooner.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions named his weapon The Last Light of Icathia?
questions.answer: It is a brazier-stave infused with elemental fire.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these is one of Aphelios' moonstone weapons?
questions.answer: Each of his five weapons is tied to a creature: a crane, a sabretooth tiger, a ram, a salamander and koi fish.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these champions wields Boneshiver, a giant True Ice club?
questions.answer: He calls it Clubbems. Lissandra gave it to him, but its true origin is unknown.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Artifacts
questions.question: Which of these is Nunu's flute?
questions.answer: It is a Notai flute whose magical notes have different effects.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the full first name Luxanna?
questions.answer: She is the younger sister of Garen; both are Crownguards.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the real name Violet?
questions.answer: She was raised in Zaun and later became a Piltover Enforcer.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the real name Ignacarious Gigantareno Rex Le Spes Offerentis?
questions.answer: He is a young terrestrial dragon, descended from Grandmother Viper.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the first name Cecil?
questions.answer: Cecil B. Heimerdinger was born in Bandle City in 675 AN, which makes him over three hundred years old.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the real name Zigmund?
questions.answer: He owns a shop in Zaun named Heimerdinger's Pyrotechnic Provisions.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name that stands for "Zaun Amorphous Combatant"?
questions.answer: He formed from a toxic spill that pooled in an isolated cavern deep beneath Zaun.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions was once known as Vander?
questions.answer: He was once a bartender, a miner and a freedom fighter in the undercity.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions was born with the name Kong?
questions.answer: He is a vastaya of the Shimon, from Shimon Village.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions uses a stage name meaning "golden excellence" in Ionian?
questions.answer: The full stage name is Khada Jhin. He is a calligrapher, painter and poet as well as a killer.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name meaning "Destruction" in Ionian?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name meaning "God of Oblivion" in Ancient Shuriman?
questions.answer: She was made from the raw material of an entire city that the Void devoured.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name meaning "Bad Stone" in Ancient Ixtali?
questions.answer: He has a son of his own, a little stone called Chip.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the first name Shauna?
questions.answer: She has dedicated her life to finding and destroying the demon that murdered her family.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the first name Malcolm?
questions.answer: He is a mercenary, gambler and thief, wanted in every city and empire he has visited.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions was once named Kegan Rodhe?
questions.answer: Before he became the Burning Vengeance, he was an apprentice of Ryze.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions was born with the name Govos?
questions.answer: The Kinkou later gave him another name, Usan.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name meaning "To understand by unmaking" in Ancient Shuriman?
questions.answer: It may have been the first Voidborn to emerge on Runeterra; none has matched its cruel, calculating sentience.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name meaning "You Face Yourself" in Ancient Shuriman?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a name meaning "one who shares" in Shuriman?

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has an ancient Shuriman name meaning "Guardian"?
questions.answer: That ancient name is Jan'ahrem. Today she protects the dispossessed of Zaun.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has a Shuriman name meaning "whom does the desert know"?
questions.answer: The name in full is Kassaiadyn.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions is reincarnated in a woman named Darha?
questions.answer: Her previous incarnation was named Jakgri.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the first name Lukai?
questions.answer: He is the heir to the Temple of Koyehn.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the family name Mori?
questions.answer: He is the last survivor of a long-forgotten religious order, blessed and cursed with power over the dead.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions was born Corin Reveck?
questions.answer: He was once a scholar at the Piltover Academy.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the family name Jhomen Tethi?
questions.answer: Her mother is Mayym Jhomen Tethi.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Names
questions.question: Which of these champions has the full name Saijax Cail-Rynx Kohari Icath'un?
questions.answer: He is the only survivor of the Kohari, the champions sworn to defend Icathia.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Relationships
questions.question: Which of these champions is married to Tryndamere?
questions.answer: He fights as the champion of her tribe.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Relationships
questions.question: Which of these champions is Caitlyn's girlfriend?
questions.answer: Caitlyn now leads Clan Kiramman as well as serving as Sheriff of Piltover.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Relationships
questions.question: Which of these champions is Rakan's girlfriend?
questions.answer: Both are vastaya of the Lhotlan tribe.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Relationships
questions.question: Which of these champions is Kai'Sa's father?
questions.answer: Both are Preservers of Valoran, who hunt the Void.

questions.subject: text
questions.label: Relationships
questions.question: Which Zaunite crime lord adopted Jinx as his daughter?
questions.answer: He and Vander had once been brothers-in-arms.

questions.subject: champion
questions.label: Relationships
questions.question: Which of these champions is Sejuani's oathfather?
questions.answer: He took her as his adopted daughter. Ashe is her estranged battlesister.

questions.subject: champion
